title: ARQ_P06
description:
Located within an urban subdivision in Lavra, Matosinhos, this single-family house is set on a plot subject to a semi-detached condition, resulting in the absence of one façade and introducing specific challenges to both spatial organization and volumetric expression.

Conceived as a four-bedroom residence, the house is structured around a clear and efficient layout. The ground floor is designed as an open-plan space, promoting continuity between the living area and the kitchen, in a solution that responds to both the client’s expectations and the permitted building areas.

Architecturally, the project is expressed as a grey-toned volume whose mass is deliberately fragmented through the design of the balcony overhangs. These elements are non-uniform and intersected, deconstructing what would otherwise be an overly continuous and static form, and introducing rhythm, depth, and dynamism to the overall composition.
